resources.name: Stillinger–Weber potential parameters for binary Si-Ge (Laradji et al., Phys. Rev. B 51, 4894 (1995))

access.notes: Extract the full set of Stillinger-Weber parameters (radial cutoff, three‑body terms, etc.) from this paper; the antiferromagnetic modification epsilon(+1,-1) = –2.3427 eV is to be applied as described in the step action.

resources.name: Numba (optional)
resources.notes: Can accelerate the Monte Carlo inner loop; not strictly required.
